garage_car_lift.title: Operate the toy car lift
garage_car_lift.caption: Pick up the green wooden toy car on the road-patterned rug and set it on the toy garage’s lower lift platform. Turn the crank to raise the car to the upper level, let it hold there, then crank it back down with the car still on the platform. Recorded mechanism test; no robot hand is shown.

clothes_drawer.title: Stow clothes in the drawer
clothes_drawer.caption: Pull open the bottom drawer of the white chest at the foot of the bed. Keep all four folded shirts in the drawer as it opens, then push the drawer fully closed with the shirts inside. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

loaded_bin_return.title: Return the loaded bin
loaded_bin_return.caption: At the cabinet beside the workbench, pull the blue bin out of the bottom middle compartment. Lift it clear with the ball inside, then lower it and slide it back into the same compartment with the ball still in it. Recorded in the simulator; no robot hand is shown.

push_road_car.title: Push the toy car
push_road_car.caption: Find the red wooden toy car on the desk side of the road-patterned rug. Push it straight ahead in the direction its nose points, then let it roll forward on its wheels and stay upright. Recorded mechanism test; no robot hand is shown.

teaching_clock.title: Set the teaching clock
teaching_clock.caption: On the clock on the workbench beside the storage bins, gently turn the short hour hand to 3 and the long minute hand to 12. Let go of both hands so the clock stays at three o’clock. Recorded mechanism test; no robot hand is shown.

train_tidy_and_play.title: Set up the train
train_tidy_and_play.caption: Lift the green rear carriage of the wooden toy train off its straight track, behind the red carriage. Set it inside the white bin on the floor beside the toy garage, then lift it out and put its wheels back on the same track behind the red carriage. Recorded mechanism test; no robot hand is shown.

turn_stool_cloth.title: Lift the stool cloth
turn_stool_cloth.caption: Recorded cloth simulation. Find the towel draped over the stool between the storage bins and the bed. Lift the low hem on the side facing the bins above the stool seat, hold it there briefly, then release it so it hangs back where it started.

turn_blanket_corner.title: Turn the blanket corner
turn_blanket_corner.caption: Recorded cloth simulation. At the foot of the bed, take the corner of the striped blanket that faces into the room, near the chest. Lift that corner clear of the mattress, hold it up briefly, then release it so it settles back in place.
